lines.text: Ask: How do you say it?
Many learners say: How to say this in English?
Better: How do you say this in English?
How do you say! How do you say this word in English?

data.wrong: How to say this in English?
data.right: How do you say this in English?

native.tip: Kita bilang “Bagaimana cara bilang ini?”, tapi bahasa Inggris butuh kalimat lengkap: How do you say this?
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “How to say this in English?” 😅 Untuk bertanya cara bilang, pakai How do you: “How do you say this in English?” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “How do you say”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “How do you say this in English?” Lalu tanyakan cara bilang satu benda di rumahmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “Bagaimana cara bilang ini?”, but English needs a full question: How do you say this?
en.caption: Ever say this? “How to say this in English?” 😅 To ask how to say it, use How do you: “How do you say this in English?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
